page_title: Free design and prototyping tool for web & mobile apps

sources.entry: Justinmind - Prototyping platform for web and mobile apps.

summary.name: Justinmind
summary.one_liner: Justinmind is a web and mobile app prototyping tool for creating clickable prototypes, wireframes and interactive simulations without coding.
use_cases: Creating clickable web or mobile app prototypes
Wireframing and iterating on UI designs
Testing app prototypes on iPhone, iPad or Android devices
Sharing prototypes with stakeholders for feedback
Building reusable UI kits and style guides for design teams
summary.what_it_does: Justinmind lets users design web and mobile interactions, including links, animations, transitions and interactive UI elements, without writing code. It includes a built-in vector design tool with a pen tool and pathfinders, plus pre-installed UI kits and components. Prototypes can be previewed live on iPhone, iPad or Android devices using its Emulator and Viewer App, and published with one click for stakeholder feedback. Multiple users can edit the same prototype at once, with version control tracking changes. Prototypes can be exported as interactive HTML, and assets as SVG or PNG, and specification documents can be generated.
notable: Live preview of prototypes on iPhone, iPad and Android via Emulator and Viewer App
Real-time multi-user editing with version control
Export to interactive HTML, SVG and PNG
One-click specification document generation with API access
caveats: Page describes the design tool as free and without project limits, but does not clearly describe paid tiers, so pricing beyond that is unclear
Mobile preview requires the separate Emulator and Viewer App
Page is largely marketing; platform support for desktop apps is not stated
